text: Reconciliation integration tests: ./gradlew :jobs:test --tests '*ReconciliationJobIT'. ITs start Postgres via Testcontainers, so Docker must be running.
Always use the Gradle wrapper (./gradlew); it pins Gradle 8.10. A system-installed gradle resolves plugins differently and breaks the build.
Spring Batch metadata tables (BATCH_JOB_*) live in schema batch_meta, created by Flyway V1__batch_meta.sql; keep spring.batch.jdbc.initialize-schema=never.
To rerun a failed job, launch it with the same identifying params (runDate=...); Spring Batch resumes at the failed step. Changing any param starts a new instance.
reconcileStep chunk size is 500; above ~1000 the multi-row insert exceeds the Postgres 65535 bind-parameter limit.
Job definitions live in jobs/src/main/java/com/ledgerline/jobs/config/, one @Configuration class per job named <Name>JobConfig.
Constructor injection only, fields final; no @Autowired fields. Lombok is banned except @Slf4j.
Branch names: <type>/LDG-<ticket>-short-desc, e.g. fix/LDG-412-skip-policy. PRs are squash-merged.
reconcileStep skips only MalformedRecordException (skipLimit 50). Never make DataAccessException skippable: it hides DB outages as skipped rows.
Local Postgres: docker compose up -d postgres. It listens on 5433, not 5432, so it doesn't clash with a host install.
Jobs are scheduled by Kubernetes CronJobs in deploy/k8s/cronjobs.yaml (02:00 UTC); @Scheduled is disabled app-wide on purpose.
To test a single step use @SpringBatchTest and jobLauncherTestUtils.launchStep("reconcileStep", params); no need to run the whole job.
Flyway files: db/migration/V<yyyyMMddHHmm>__short_desc.sql. Never edit an applied migration; add a new one.
Bank statements arrive as CAMT.053 XML under s3://ledgerline-inbound/<bank>/ and are read with StaxEventItemReader.
Formatting is Spotless with google-java-format (AOSP style): run ./gradlew spotlessApply. CI fails on spotlessCheck.
ItemProcessors must be stateless. Keep per-run totals in the StepExecution ExecutionContext, otherwise a restart double-counts.
Logs are JSON (logstash encoder) with jobExecutionId in the MDC; filter on it in Kibana.
Release: tag vX.Y.Z on main; Actions builds the image and Argo CD syncs it. No manual kubectl apply.
Set testcontainers.reuse.enable=true in ~/.testcontainers.properties; IT startup drops from ~20s to ~2s per run.
Amounts are BigDecimal, scale 2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN. Never double or float; compare with compareTo, not equals.
Shared DTOs live in common/src/main/java/com/ledgerline/common/dto; the jobs module must not depend on the api module.
The Java 21 toolchain is set in build.gradle.kts; set IntelliJ's Project SDK to 21 too or records and switch patterns fail to compile.
A failed nightly run pages via the BatchJobFailed alert; ack it, then check the failing step at /actuator/batchstatus.
The api module only reads reconciliation results; it has no JobLauncher bean and must never start jobs.
Flutter is pinned with fvm (.fvmrc: 3.24.3); run fvm flutter ... A global flutter of another version builds with the wrong engine.
Unit and widget tests: fvm flutter test. Golden tests are tagged 'golden' and only run with --tags golden.
Goldens are generated on the macOS CI runner only; fonts render differently elsewhere, so local --update-goldens output fails CI.
Codegen (freezed, riverpod_generator, drift): dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs. Generated files aren't committed.
State is Riverpod 2 with codegen (@riverpod). Don't add ChangeNotifier or provider-package classes; those are legacy being removed.
Routes are declared in lib/app/router.dart (go_router); a new deep link like /list/:id also needs an iOS Associated Domains entry.
Local DB is drift (lib/data/db/app_db.dart): any table change needs a schemaVersion bump and a step in MigrationStrategy.onUpgrade.
google-services.json and GoogleService-Info.plist are not in git; get them from the team password manager vault pantrypal-dev.
After adding a plugin run cd ios && pod install; Xcode's 'Module not found' almost always means stale pods.
Lints: very_good_analysis. Prefer const constructors, single quotes and trailing commas; run dart format . before committing.
Barcode scanning uses mobile_scanner; its camera permission text lives in ios/Runner/Info.plist and must be localized.
Widgets never call HTTP directly: go through a repository in lib/data/repositories exposed by a provider.
Android signing: key.properties stays local (gitignored); CI signs with the upload keystore from repository secrets.
Recipe images use cached_network_image with a 200 MB disk cap configured in main.dart.
PR titles must be Conventional Commits; the title becomes the squash commit message.
Two flavors, dev and prod: fvm flutter run --flavor dev -t lib/main_dev.dart. Without --flavor, Gradle can't find the APK.
Integration tests: fvm flutter test integration_test --flavor dev -d <device-id>; they need a real device or an emulator.
Shopping lists are offline-first: writes hit drift, SyncWorker pushes to Firestore when online; conflicts are last-write-wins per item.
No hardcoded user-facing text: add strings to lib/l10n/app_en.arb and run fvm flutter gen-l10n.
Minimum OS: Android minSdk 23, iOS 13. A plugin needing more is a team decision, not a drive-by bump.
Store release: bump version in pubspec.yaml (x.y.z+build), then run fastlane beta in ios/ and android/.
Add packages with dart pub add <pkg> (or --dev), not by hand-editing pubspec.yaml; pubspec.lock is committed.
Colors come from Theme.of(context).colorScheme and lib/app/theme/tokens.dart; Colors.* literals break dark mode.
Meal planner weeks start on the locale's firstDayOfWeekIndex (MaterialLocalizations), never a hardcoded Monday.
Local env is Laravel Sail: ./vendor/bin/sail up -d. Run php, artisan and composer through sail so you get PHP 8.3, not the host PHP.
Tests are Pest: sail artisan test --parallel. Feature tests use RefreshDatabase against the mysql_testing container.
Run one test file: sail artisan test tests/Feature/Appointments/BookAppointmentTest.php --filter=<name>.
Double booking is blocked by a unique index on (doctor_id, slot_start) plus SELECT ... FOR UPDATE in BookingService; app-only checks race.
Timestamps are stored in UTC and returned as ISO-8601 with offset; local time uses clinics.timezone, never config('app.timezone').
Never edit a merged migration; add a new one. Schema changes on appointments (big table) run via pt-online-schema-change in prod: ask the DBA first.
Thin controllers: validate with FormRequest classes, put logic in app/Services, return API Resources.
Static analysis: sail composer stan (Larastan level 8). New code must not add entries to phpstan-baseline.neon; fix the error instead.
Code style is Pint: sail pint. CI runs pint --test.
Queues run on Redis with Horizon. The /horizon dashboard is enabled only in local; reminder SMS jobs use the notifications queue.
Horizon workers keep old code in memory: after changing a job class run sail artisan horizon:terminate so they restart.
SMS goes through Twilio in prod; locally the log driver writes every message to storage/logs/sms.log.
Auth is Sanctum tokens with abilities patient or staff; check $request->user()->tokenCan('staff'), not a role column.
Versioned routes: routes/api_v1.php and routes/api_v2.php. v1 is frozen (bug fixes only); new endpoints go in v2.
Demo data: sail artisan migrate:fresh --seed --seeder=DemoClinicSeeder (3 clinics, 12 doctors).
/api/v2/slots is limited to 60 req/min per token via RateLimiter::for('slots') in AppServiceProvider::boot.
API docs are generated by Scribe: sail artisan scribe:generate. Never edit public/docs by hand.
Branches: feature/CQ-<ticket>-slug. PRs need one approval and green CI; squash merge only.
Feature flags use Laravel Pennant (classes in app/Features); gate code with Feature::active('waitlist') and similar.
Lab report uploads go to a private S3 bucket and are served via temporary signed URLs valid for 10 minutes.
Never log PHI: no patient names, phones or emails in Log:: calls. Log patient_id only.
Envoyer deploys on merge to main and runs migrate --force and horizon:terminate automatically.
Cancellation is allowed until clinics.cancel_window_hours before slot_start (default 24h), configurable per clinic.
Mailables implement ShouldQueue; preview them locally at /mail-preview/{mailable}.
